description: This file defines authentication API endpoints for login and registration, including user validation, token creation, and user/admin registration logic within a FastAPI application.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance configured for authentication routes.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Schema for JWT token response data.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Schema for registration request payload, accommodating both user and admin registration.

classes.name: BaseResponse
classes.description: Standard response schema indicating success or failure and a message.

classes.name: AdminCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating an admin, including optional permission fields.

classes.name: Admin
classes.description: Database model representing an administrator user.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a regular user.

methods.name: login( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Authenticates user/admin credentials and issues a JWT token if valid.

methods.name: register( request: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Registers a new user or admin based on provided data, with schema validation, duplicate checks, and password hashing.

ctags.name: login
ctags.signature: ( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
